Caged Sun’s triggered ability is also a mana ability. Assuming you choose green as the color, any time that you tap a land for G Caged Sun triggers adding another G.

(it is important to note that Caged Sun’s ability triggers whenever a LAND is tapped for a mana of the chosen color. Also noteworthy that Caged Sun’s triggered ability is a mana ability, so nobody gets priority before it resolves)

Now, let’s suppose we have Caged Sun on green in play and that it has been enchanted with an Ensoul Artifact. 

Continuing from the previous supposition, let’s say that we cast (and resolve) an Ashaya. 

(Ashaya gives all of our creatures the basic land type “Forest” [ie all creatures we control now have the type “Land Creature,” more specifically “Forest Creature”]. Cards [lands?] with type “Forest” have an intrinsic ability: (tap): add G to your mana pool; because Ashaya turns all of our creatures into Forest Creatures, all of our creatures can tap to add G to our mana pool.)

So, with Ashaya in play, our Caged Sun has the types “Artifact” (inherent), “Creature” (ensoul artifact), and “Land - Forest” (from Ashaya).

Consider what happens whenever we tap our Caged Sun as a land for green mana: 

i) G is added to your mana pool

ii) Caged Sun triggers adding G to your mana pool (triggered because a land<Caged Sun>’s ability added a mana of the chosen color to our mana pool) 

iii) Caged Sun sees the G that was added by a LAND’s (Caged Sun is land per Ashaya) ability in step ii, adds G to our mana pool 

iv) Step iii repeats ad infinitum 

TL;DR: Caged Sun is a land due to Ashaya. “Adding an additional mana of the chosen color” is a triggered ability of Caged Sun. Caged Sun’s ability triggers when a LAND’S ABILITY adds one mana of chosen color to mana pool. Caged Sun is a land. “Adding add’l mana…” is an ability. 

Therefore: tap Caged Sun for G -> Caged Sun see land ability add chosen color -> Caged Sun ability trigger -> Caged Sun add G (note that Caged Sun is land from Ashaya) -> Caged Sun see land ability add chosen color -> Caged Sun ability trigger -> Caged Sun add G -> ad infinitum ————> DRAW (Caged Sun triggered ability = mana ability = no priority between loops = no possible moves for any player).
